stances_toward.note: Claimed, not controlled: France has administered Mayotte throughout, and Comoros claims the island in its own UN statements (2012 general debate). The UN record of the claim is the 1976 Security Council veto by France of a draft recognising Comorian sovereignty, which had 11 votes in favour. Bond grievance: an open wound from independence that the Comorian state has never closed. Trend stable: no source read shows the claim softening. Confidence B: two tier 1 UN records, cited through Wikipedia and not opened here; the date of the claim as a whole (independence, 1975) is not cited and the since field uses the first UN record.
